Data Protection

  • Controller: Jordi Perelló (TourAI project / TourAI App).
  • Purpose: Handling and responding to the enquiry submitted.
  • Legal basis: Consent by ticking the box.
  • Recipients: Data will not be disclosed to third parties for their own commercial purposes. Providers that supply hosting, authentication, database or email-sending services may access the data, acting as processors under TourAI's instructions.
  • Rights: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection by writing to info@tourai.es. Account deletion is automatic from the app or the Delete account page.

For further details, please see our full Privacy Policy.
